items.question: What is PM Structure?
items.answer: PM Structure is an independent exam-preparation and project management learning platform. We offer structured readiness pathways for PMI®, PRINCE2®, and Lean Six Sigma—not official exams and not a certification body. See Terms and pricing disclaimers.

items.question: Is PM Structure an official PMI or PRINCE2 training provider?
items.answer: Today we operate as an independent exam-prep platform. Certification names and trademarks belong to their respective owners. PM Structure currently operates as an independent exam-prep platform. Accreditation status, official provider status, contact-hour eligibility, and PDU eligibility will be stated only where formally approved. See our pricing disclaimers.

items.question: What certifications does PM Structure cover?
items.answer: We support pathways across PMI (PMP®, CAPM®, PMI-ACP®), PRINCE2®, and Lean Six Sigma belts. Browse /certifications or compare.

items.question: Who is PM Structure for?
items.answer: Working professionals and career-changers preparing for project, program, and process-improvement credentials. You must meet each certification body’s eligibility before scheduling an official exam.

items.question: What is PM Structure's brand promise?
items.answer: Prepare with structure. Manage with discipline. Deliver with control.

items.question: What are Foundation, Professional, and Mastery tiers?
items.answer: Foundation is a shorter orientation phase. Professional is main exam-focused preparation (LMS, mocks, templates, support). Mastery is mentor-led with live sessions and consultation where required. See each certification page for scope.

items.question: What is included in Professional tier delivery?
items.answer: Typical Professional delivery includes exam-focused LMS, practice exams, templates, WhatsApp support, and limited review—varies by offering. Check the pathway card on your certification page.

items.question: What is included in Mastery tier delivery?
items.answer: Mastery is mentor-led with weekend or live sessions, WhatsApp support, and consultation before access for some offerings. Mastery may require approved consultation before checkout.

items.question: What is Foundation tier for?
items.answer: Foundation helps you understand pathway structure, exam domains at a high level, and study planning before intensive prep.

items.question: Can I skip Foundation and start at Professional?
items.answer: Where Professional checkout is available and you meet prerequisites, you may enroll directly. Book a consultation if unsure.

items.question: How do I choose between PMP, CAPM, and PRINCE2?
items.answer: CAPM suits entry-level roles. PMP suits experienced leaders meeting PMI hours. PRINCE2 suits governance-focused roles. Use /certifications/compare.

items.question: How long does it take to prepare for the PMP exam?
items.answer: Many candidates plan 2–4 months (often 100+ hours). Align your timeline with PMI eligibility and Pearson VUE scheduling.

items.question: Does PM Structure guarantee I will pass?
items.answer: No. PM Structure does not guarantee exam passes, certifications, PDU/contact hours, or employment. We provide structured preparation and readiness reviews.

items.question: Are practice exams updated for the current PMP exam format?
items.answer: We align to the current PMI Exam Content Outline (ECO). Verify the latest ECO on PMI.org before scheduling.

items.question: What is a readiness review?
items.answer: A structured check of mock scores, weak domains, and study plan before you book the official exam—on higher tiers or via consultation.

items.question: When should I schedule my official exam?
items.answer: After you meet certification body eligibility and mocks/readiness indicate preparedness. Book exams with PMI, PeopleCert, or IASSC directly.

items.question: Is training live or self-paced?
items.answer: Foundation and some tiers are self-paced LMS. Professional blends self-paced with support. Mastery includes mentor-led sessions. See each offering’s delivery mode on the pathway page.

items.question: How do I access course materials after purchase?
items.answer:

• Email support at support@pmstructure.com with your order email and offering ID if access is delayed.
